data_sources.provider: Binance public spot klines (via data.loader.DataLoader / data.cache.load_cached)
data_sources.notes: Only real fetched/cached candles used. No synthetic candles, IV, volume, fills, order books, labels, or metrics fabricated as evidence.

method.strategy: Multi-timeframe pairs: 1h trailing cointegration/hedge/spread context gates + 5m z-score entry/exit.
method.causal_alignment: 1h bar at index t (open label) becomes available at t+1h (close). merge_asof backward on available_at maps to 5m bars at/after close; no 5m bar uses 1h information before close.

1h: Engle-Granger/coint p-value (AIC) when available else ADF-on-spread proxy
5m: rolling z-score from causally aligned spread

method.wf_leakage_controls: No train/test optimization on this artifact; evaluation uses causal rolling trailing windows and causal 1h->5m availability. Purged WF not separately claimed beyond causal construction; leakage sanity checked.
method.cost_model: Per-bar turnover * (fee_rate + slippage_bps/10000) on 5m positions shifted by 1 bar; gross-normalized pair legs; no fabricated fills/order books.
limitations: Historical L2/intrabar replay not publicly available from public routes used; fills/order books are not fabricated.
5m execution is close-to-close proxy with explicit fee+slippage+turnover costs, not exchange matching-engine replay.
1h cointegration/half-life/correlation gates are trailing statistical diagnostics on real candles; fail-closed and not proof of future edge.
Universe/windows limited to real data successfully fetched/cached in this environment; any unavailable route/symbol is recorded honestly.

causal_alignment.rule: 1h bar at t informs 5m bars only at/after t + 1h (bar close); merge_asof backward on availability timestamp
